name: Division
description: Share a total out equally, or measure it into equal groups — then say what is left over and what it means.
author: Koda Math Lab
tagline: Sharing out, grouping up, and the bit left over.

features.name: Spoken voice
features.description: Reads the question, speaks hints, and says why the tray will not take an answer yet. Turn off for a silent lesson.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Plays a sound as a counter is dealt and when an answer is checked.

features.name: Haptic vibration
features.description: Adds a small vibration to dealing a counter and to checking an answer.

features.name: Group counts
features.description: Shows how many counters are in each group as they are dealt.

features.name: Smart guide
features.description: Lets the Smart guide speak up on its own when a child stalls or drops the technique. Off, it waits to be asked — the Hint button opens the same guide.

features.name: Smart guide voice
features.description: Reads each step of the Smart guide aloud as it appears. Off, a child reads it without hearing it — the guide itself stays either way.

features.name: Helper fact
features.description: Shows the matching multiplication beside the division being worked. Never offered during practice.

settingsSchema.label: Smart guide patience
settingsSchema.help: How long a child is left to think before the Smart guide steps in. Relaxed waits about eleven seconds, Quick about four.

settingsSchema.label: How remainders are written
settingsSchema.help: Classrooms differ. A child copying a different form from school reads their own correct answer as wrong.
